info.author: JorgeEcheva
info.name: aef-gw
info.summary: AEF_GW is a component designed to facilitate the integration of legacy systems with the **Common API Framework (CAPIF)**. It streamlines the process, enabling legacy systems to interact with CAPIF, ensuring compatibility and simplifying the adoption of modern APIs.
